f13_ready_body_barrier.source_generation: four immutable body receipts are checked for the same source generation before queue mutation
f13_ready_body_barrier.suppression: source0/1 still push/pop queues but skip EMDF serialization, complexity/carrier validation, and provide typed ABSENT_PUBLISHED_PAYLOAD_V1 to F12; source1 ID14 writer0 is popped and discarded
f13_ready_body_barrier.codec_frame_effect: F12 still builds a complete 4096-byte scratch frame and computes/validates the E-AC-3 CRC16 for source0/1; only published metadata fields are absent, and no AU is appended

f13_container.prefix: bytes 0..1 are 0x58 0x38; bytes2..3 are BE U16 body byte length
f13_container.item_syntax: ID U5, conditional configuration, variable unsigned length, payload bytes
f13_container.terminator: ID0 then primary length code2 (4 protection bytes) and secondary length code1 (1 protection byte), checksum slots, zero pad to byte
f13_container.protection_slot_offsets: dynamic offsets from the complete F13 serialization; do not use fixed absolute offsets or patch by scanning reference bytes
f13_container.total_length_C: complete container bytes including four-byte prefix
f13_container.body_length_B: C-4; C<=511 and therefore selected B<=507
f13_container.capacity_guard: queue capacity, complete container bound, F12 U9 carrier length, and F12 remaining frame-bit budget are separate constraints

carriage_mode.mode_rule: selected explicitly at programme boundary and immutable for the programme; omission uses only the F13.9 documented default
carriage_mode.boundary: etsi_emdf is experimental and does not claim whole-stream ETSI or decoder conformance; mode changes require a fresh complete F13 serialization and F12 frame trial

keyless_public_integrity.private_authentication: excluded; no HMAC key/material is an input

emdf_crc8.input: the four primary CRC32 bytes in wire order

single_write_owner_rule.selected_f15_call_order: F13 ready container -> F14K primary/secondary CRC patch -> F12 writes the carrier skip/payload, frame tail, and CRC16 semantics -> F15 receives completed 4096-byte frame
single_write_owner_rule.separate_integrity_root_note: INTEGRITY-OWNER-ROOT-V1 also models SOURCE/DISPATCH/AU receipts; its DISPATCH/AU mutating wrapper must not be run as a second skip/CRC writer on an already completed F12 frame. If selected as an owner wrapper, it needs a named adapter so each wire range has one writer.
